z1.conclusion: Across the four thresholds 0 swap(s) and 3 not-separated sign change(s) occur among 45 method pairs (all 10 models), shares of signal stay within 0.14 to 0.99, and the highest Spearman with E is 1.00 (attribution patching).

z3.conclusion: The median Spearman of E between models is 0.33 (split-half over stimuli inside a model: 1.00), the median top-61 overlap is 20 classes (Jaccard 0.20), 3 classes are core and 190 variable, and the Spearman between the CV of the scalar and the CV of the effect is 0.38.

z4.conclusion: Spearman between the ablation effect E and the task effect T is 0.67 (mean over 10 models), the top-61 sets of E and T share 36.6 classes on average, and in the mean over models 34 classes are high on E but low on T and 34 the reverse; the best method against T is |weights| x neuron activity, per edge with AUROC 0.94.

z6.conclusion: Across 63 source types the silencing effect has Spearman 0.98 with the sum and 0.97 with the maximum of the effects of the outgoing classes (mean over models); 12 types are masking (below 0.5 x the sum) and 7 the reverse (above 1.5 x the sum) in the mean over models.
